limitation: The vendor dates the driver package and does not give a separate Print Panel release date.
notes: The version and architecture describe the Print Panel app shipped with the driver. Other driver components may differ.

name: ScanSnap Manager
product: PFU (Ricoh, formerly Fujitsu) ScanSnap Manager for Mac

evidence.says: PFU ended ScanSnap Manager distribution and support on November 7, 2024 and named ScanSnap Home as its successor.
PFU lists V7.2L70 or later for macOS Sonoma and lists ScanSnap Manager as unavailable for later major macOS versions.
Rosetta Check’s reported installation data identifies 7.2.70.1001 for the exact bundle ID as Intel-only.

limitation: An Intel-only build was documented for 7.2.70.1001. The final Mac release and its architecture could not be verified.
notes: ScanSnap Home is the successor. Its native Apple Silicon support does not establish ScanSnap Manager’s architecture.

name: HP Easy Admin
product: HP Easy Admin for macOS, HP Inc.

evidence.says: The HP Easy Admin 2.16.0 executable at HP Easy Admin.app/Contents/MacOS/HP Easy Admin has x86_64 and arm64 Mach-O slices and the app plist matches com.hp.hp-easy-admin.
Homebrew identifies the same HP ZIP as its current 2.16.0 build 251010 download.

limitation: An official release date was not verified.
notes: The official ZIP contains build 251010.

name: NoMachine
product: NoMachine Personal Edition remote desktop for Mac, NoMachine S.à r.l.

evidence.says: The live download page serves the Mac Personal Edition 10.2.3_1 package and explicitly says the Mac package includes x86 and Apple Silicon code.
The vendor announced NoMachine 10.2.3 on October 6, 2026 and lists both Intel and Apple Silicon macOS as supported.

notes: The current Mac download is build 10.2.3_1. NoMachine Player is the separately distributed standalone client.

name: FBWS
product: HiTRUST FBWS, First Commercial Bank i-Bank’s macOS security component

evidence.says: First Bank’s installation guide lists FBWS.app version 1.1802.03.14 as a component of its Internet banking security installer.
First Bank’s macOS update instructions identify FBWS as the resident i-Bank security component and reference the same version.

notes: The version identifies FBWS.app inside the bank’s installer.

name: ClassIn
product: ClassIn virtual classroom desktop app by EEO

evidence.says: ClassIn offers separate macOS downloads for Intel processors and Apple silicon.
The vendor's download configuration points the Apple silicon option to classin_mac_install_6.0.9.3155_arm64.dmg.

limitation: The vendor does not give a release date for this build.

name: Delay-Start
product: Delay Start by Joseph Markham

evidence.says: Apple's live lookup identifies the current Mac App Store release as Delay Start 1.1 for com.Cyberdyne.Delay-Start, dated 2013-02-14.
The published scan contains the matching 1.1 bundle metadata and reports only a 64-bit x86 architecture.

limitation: No report tied to this exact app and version verified Rosetta behavior.

name: Soda Player
product: Soda Player desktop media player by Soda Player

evidence.says: The Mac archive identifies 1.4.2 as the last update and reports that the developer no longer maintains or distributes the app.
MacUpdate records the same 1.4.2 Mac build as 64-bit Intel.

limitation: The former official site could not be reached and a vendor release date and Rosetta runtime behavior could not be verified.
notes: Mirrors retain the final Intel build. The same-named iOS App Store app has a different developer.

name: AudioBookBinder
product: AudioBookBinder by BluezBox (gonzoua)

evidence.says: The original AudioBookBinder project provides release 2.5 for Mac.
Inspection of AudiobookBinder-2.5.dmg identified com.bluezbox.AudioBookBinder version 2.5 with an x86_64 and arm64 universal AudioBookBinder.app/Contents/MacOS/AudioBookBinder executable.

notes: The original BluezBox app is distributed from the project repository. Other App Store products use similar names.

name: Iridient X-Transformer
product: Iridient X-Transformer for macOS, Iridient Digital

evidence.says: Iridient lists version 4.5 for macOS and dates it June 5, 2026.
The official DMG contains Iridient X-Transformer.app/Contents/MacOS/Iridient X-Transformer with x86_64 and arm64 slices and the matching bundle ID.

notes: The DMG plist also records build 2026.06.

name: CLAS Student GDCP
product: CLAS Student GDCP, Mac student client for the Competency-Linked Assessment System by Mark McMinn (114 Consulting)

evidence.says: McMinn's 2019 CV identifies CLAS as his four-app Competency-Linked Assessment System suite.
The archived scan establishes that this exact Mac bundle was a 64-bit Intel app at version 2.26.
Apple's current U.S. storefront lookup returns zero results for this Mac bundle ID.

limitation: No current listing, vendor download, or withdrawal notice for the exact Mac client was located.
notes: The name also appears on a related iPhone and iPad client. The 2.26 Mac scan does not establish the last release.

name: McSolitaire
product: PCV Soft’s McSolitaire for Mac

evidence.says: PCV describes McSolitaire as the predecessor whose engine is used in its current Top Solitaire product.
Apple’s US Mac App Store lookup returns no result for the original McSolitaire product ID.
CHIP’s McSolitaire 4.3 download page reports that its Mac App Store distribution has ended.
The original 4.3 scan for this bundle ID records both 32-bit and 64-bit Intel executable slices and no arm64 slice.

limitation: Version 4.3 is the latest Mac build located. Rosetta 2 operation was not verified.
notes: PCV’s separate successor Top Solitaire added native Apple Silicon support in 2.1.

name: Drive Clean
product: FIPLAB Ltd. Drive Clean – Manage & Clear Junk Files from External Drives

evidence.says: Mac Fan’s review identifies Drive Clean as a separately distributed FIPLAB utility and links to its Mac App Store product ID.
Apple’s US Mac App Store lookup returns no result for the former Drive Clean product ID.
FIPLAB’s current catalog lists its downloadable apps and omits Drive Clean.
The original scan records FIPLAB’s Drive Clean bundle version 1.3 with a single 64-bit Intel executable slice.

limitation: The vendor’s end date and the final Mac version were not confirmed. The latest identified build, 1.3, was Intel-only.
notes: Drive Clean was a standalone utility sold on the Mac App Store.

name: Backgammon Reloaded 3D
product: Catalin Stan (catalinux) Backgammon Reloaded 3D for macOS

evidence.says: This archival storefront record identifies Catalin Stan’s Mac version 5, dated April 13, 2017, and reports that it has been removed from the French Mac App Store.
The archived Mac product record ties Catalin Stan’s Backgammon Reloaded 3D to App Store ID 1217219761.
Apple’s US Mac App Store lookup returns no result for the separate Mac product ID.
The original scan identifies the exact macOS bundle as version 5 and records a single Intel executable slice.
Apple identifies the separate version 6 listing as an iPhone and iPad app that can run on Apple Silicon Macs.

limitation: The delisting date and Rosetta 2 operation for version 5 were not verified.
notes: The Intel Mac edition used App Store ID 1217219761. The differently numbered mobile edition used ID 1218036582.

name: CodeBlocks
product: Code::Blocks IDE by the Code::Blocks team

evidence.says: The official binary page lists only an x64 macOS DMG for version 25.03 and flags instability with the Mac build.
The team announced Code::Blocks 25.03 on 2025-03-31.
An Apple silicon compatibility report documents running the exact x64 release with Rosetta 2 in Safe Mode, which disables problematic IDE plugins.
A user reports startup and compiler failures with the official x64 DMG on macOS 27.0.1 and submits a community arm64 build for review.

limitation: The reported Rosetta workflow depends on Safe Mode and external compiler tools. Normal startup and integrated builds may fail.

name: Dogecoin-Qt
product: Dogecoin-Qt GUI in Dogecoin Core for macOS, Dogecoin Core developers

evidence.says: The project identifies 1.14.9 as the official Dogecoin Core release and supplies the unsigned macOS DMG.
The reproducible macOS build recipe for v1.14.9 specifies x86_64-apple-darwin11 as its sole target.

limitation: No verified report tied successful Rosetta 2 operation to this official Mac build.
notes: The published Mac DMG is unsigned.

name: ReiBoot
product: Tenorshare ReiBoot iOS system repair for Mac, Tenorshare

evidence.says: Tenorshare identifies this product as ReiBoot for iOS recovery and links the current Mac installer.
The official DMG contains ReiBoot.app/Contents/MacOS/ReiBoot as an Intel x86_64 Mach-O with no arm64 slice and the corresponding plist matches the original bundle ID.

limitation: A release date and successful operation under Rosetta 2 were not verified for this build.
notes: The current vendor DMG contains build 9.6.1.5.

name: PerfDog
product: Tencent WeTest PerfDog desktop performance testing tool for macOS

evidence.says: Tencent WeTest currently advertises a macOS desktop download for PerfDog.
The international macOS download redirects to PerfDog(iv13.2.261046).dmg, whose HTTP headers report a 567,490,575-byte package.
Tencent’s Chinese macOS download separately serves PerfDog(v13.2.261052).dmg.

limitation: Neither download identifies its executable architecture, and both packages exceed the audit’s 150 MB inspection limit.
notes: The version field refers to the international desktop package. Tencent also ships a separate China desktop build.

name: Wizard101
product: KingsIsle Entertainment’s Wizard101 North American macOS client

evidence.says: KingsIsle’s Mac update feed advertises Wizard101 1.30 dated November 10, 2026 as a 387,110,711-byte DMG.
KingsIsle’s original release announcement identifies its own Mac client for Wizard101.
A September 2026 player reports playing the Intel Mac client through Rosetta, before the 1.30 release.

limitation: The current 1.30 architecture and Rosetta behavior remain unverified. The confirmed September Rosetta report predates this version, and the November DMG exceeds the inspection limit.
notes: The North American Mac build is a separate distribution from Wizard101 Europe.

name: dBpoweramp Video Converter
product: dBpoweramp Video Converter for macOS, Illustrate

evidence.says: Illustrate lists R2026-03-23 as the current Mac Video Converter release in its version history.
The official trial contains dBpoweramp Video Converter.app/Contents/MacOS/dBpoweramp Video Converter with x86_64 and arm64 slices, and the app plist matches the scanned bundle ID.

name: Popup Window Free
product: Popup Window Free direct-download trial by Catalystwo

evidence.says: Catalystwo still offers the direct-download free trial version 1.3.5 and labels the separate 1.4b2 download as beta.
Inspection confirmed that Popup Window Free.app/Contents/MacOS/Popup Window Free is x86_64-only and the app is com.catalystwo.Popup-Window-Free version 1.3.5.
Apple identifies the maintained Popup Window Lite App Store edition with the distinct bundle ID com.catalystwo.Popup-WindowFree.

limitation: No Rosetta runtime report or release date for the exact direct-download trial was located.
notes: The vendor's separate 1.4b2 beta uses com.catalystwo.Popup-Window. The App Store Lite edition also has a different bundle ID.

name: Xencelabs
product: Xencelabs tablet settings app from the Xencelabs macOS driver package

evidence.says: The vendor lists XencelabsMac_1.3.5-109 as its current Mac driver package and dates the posting November 24, 2026.
Xencelabs states that its Mac driver runs natively on Apple silicon starting with 1.3.1-52.
Inspection of XencelabsMac_1.3.5-109.zip found a universal x86_64 and arm64 Xencelabs.app/Contents/MacOS/Xencelabs settings executable in the package.

limitation: The settings app itself has no version in its Info.plist. The version and date are for the vendor's enclosing driver release.
notes: The current package uses com.hanvon.Xencelabs for Xencelabs.app and its inner DMG filename includes Beta, while the main vendor download page lists the package as its current macOS download.

name: SysEx Librarian
product: SysEx Librarian for macOS, Snoize (Kurt Revis)

evidence.says: Snoize lists 1.5.2 as the current Mac release and dates it October 21, 2023.
The official 1.5.2 DMG contains SysEx Librarian.app/Contents/MacOS/SysEx Librarian with x86_64 and arm64 slices and the matching bundle ID.

name: Duplicate File Finder & Remover
product: Duplicate File Finder & Remover for Mac, CleverFiles

evidence.says: The vendor describes this standalone Mac utility and directs users to App Store item 1152611077.
Apple's US Mac software lookup returns zero results for the vendor's App Store ID.
MacUpdate archives version 2.0 and carries a report that CleverFiles withdrew the standalone app.

limitation: The exact withdrawal date, version 2.0 release date and final binary architecture were not verified.
notes: The 2021 scan identifies the older Intel build 1.2 as com.cf.dff. A similarly named Nektony product has a different bundle ID.

name: Firewall
product: Firewall – Network Monitor for Mac, Paragon Software Group

evidence.says: Paragon identifies this outbound firewall and links its Mac App Store distribution.
Apple's lookup identifies the listing as com.paragon-software.FirewallApp version 2.2 and dates it October 10, 2024.
The Mac App Store specifies macOS 10.15 or later without stating the binary architecture.

limitation: The App Store release and bundle ID are verifiable, but no architecture evidence was found for the distributed 2.2 binary.
notes: The vendor also publishes a Community Edition source repository.

name: SIDPLAY
product: SIDPLAY 4 for Mac, Andreas Varga

evidence.says: The original update feed lists 4.2 as its newest release and links SIDPLAY4.zip.
The official ZIP contains the matching org.sidmusic.sidplay version 4.2 and its SIDPLAY.app/Contents/MacOS/SIDPLAY executable is x86_64 only.
The SIDPLAY 5 project describes itself as an upgrade of the earlier SIDPLAY app and documents its own Apple Silicon support.

limitation: No verified report establishes Rosetta 2 operation for this original build.
notes: SIDPLAY 5 is a separate fork.
